summary: Iteration 9 tests validated the assign-courier OFFER flow after the reported bug fix. Backend: 5/5 tests passed (list couriers returns name+code+status; PATCH /orders/{oid}/assign-courier with an accepted courier creates courier_offer.status='pending' WITHOUT setting order.courier; assigning to a pending/unlinked courier returns 404; courier sees offer via GET /courier/me/offers; accept sets order.courier and offer.status='accepted'; refuse clears offer/courier and sets courier_refused). Frontend: on /(lojista)/order/[id], the 'Entregador' section lists ONLY accepted couriers as chips, each showing NAME + courier_code (e.g., 'Carlos Moto' + 'ZF-LBRXQ'). Tapping a chip immediately updates the section to 'Oferta enviada para X — aguardando aceite' and highlights the selected chip. Everything works as described. Note: React Native Web Alert.alert() renders as an HTML modal (not a browser window.alert), so the Playwright 'dialog' event does not fire — the visual state transition confirms feedback. No mocked APIs, no deprecated packages detected in the reference files.
critical_code_review_comments: Console warnings visible in web preview: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated (use boxShadow) and 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated' — these come from framework/library code, not the fixed screen. Non-blocking but worth cleaning up when RN upgrades.

queue.tsx card testID is placed on the outer <View> while the navigation Pressable is nested inside, so tapping via testid='queue-order-<id>' may not always trigger navigation in the web preview. Not blocking (direct route works), but consider moving testID onto the Pressable for more reliable e2e taps.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_iter8_assign_offer_flow.py (replaced non-existent /users/me with /auth/me; register accepts 200/201; product/address fetch aligned with real endpoints /stores/{id} and /addresses)
seed_data_creation: Created a few TEST_ couriers (via /courier/register) and TEST_iter9 addresses for the demo cliente. No production data touched. Existing seeded Carlos Moto (ZF-LBRXQ) reused.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. Order creation requires address_id (POST /addresses first). courier/register returns 201. User info endpoint is /api/auth/me (NOT /users/me). Store products come embedded in GET /stores/{id} (no /stores/{id}/products route). For UI, prefer direct navigation to /(lojista)/order/<id> because queue card testID is on the outer View not the Pressable. RN Web Alert.alert renders as inline HTML — do not rely on Playwright 'dialog' event; assert on the state text ('Oferta enviada para X — aguardando aceite').
rca_of_issue: Original bug: lojista attribution had no visible feedback and appeared not to work because the endpoint uses an OFFER flow (courier_offer.status='pending') and order.courier is only set on courier accept. Fix already applied by main agent: (1) GET /my/couriers returns name+courier_code+status so chips render 'NAME + ZF-CODE'; (2) after PATCH /orders/{oid}/assign-courier the UI immediately shows the Alert 'Oferta enviada ✅' and updates the section to 'Oferta enviada para X — aguardando aceite' with the selected chip highlighted; (3) once courier accepts via POST /orders/{oid}/offer-response {accept:true}, order.courier is set and the section shows 'Aceito: X • placa (ZF-...)'. All verified end-to-end.
